```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r}
library(here)
library(frictionless)
library(camtrapdp)
```

```{r}
# Read the three tables exported from COAT
deployments <- read.csv(here::here("interim", "deployments.csv"))
media <- read.csv(here::here("interim", "media.csv"))
observations <- read.csv(here::here("interim", "observations.csv"))
```

## Check that the three tables conform to the Camtrap DP schemas
```{r}
# --- Compare data frames to Camtrap DP schemas ---
library(jsonlite)

# Compare deployments
deployments_schema_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tdwg/camtrap-dp/1.0.2/deployments-table-schema.json"
deployments_schema <- fromJSON(deployments_schema_url)
deployments_expected <- deployments_schema$fields$name
deployments_actual <- colnames(deployments)
cat("\nDeployments table:\n")
cat("Missing fields: ", paste(setdiff(deployments_expected, deployments_actual), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Extra fields: ", paste(setdiff(deployments_actual, deployments_expected), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Compare media
media_schema_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tdwg/camtrap-dp/1.0.2/media-table-schema.json"
media_schema <- fromJSON(media_schema_url)
media_expected <- media_schema$fields$name
media_actual <- colnames(media)
cat("\nMedia table:\n")
cat("Missing fields: ", paste(setdiff(media_expected, media_actual), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Extra fields: ", paste(setdiff(media_actual, media_expected), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Compare observations
observations_schema_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tdwg/camtrap-dp/1.0.2/observations-table-schema.json"
observations_schema <- fromJSON(observations_schema_url)
observations_expected <- observations_schema$fields$name
observations_actual <- colnames(observations)
cat("\nObservations table:\n")
cat("Missing fields: ", paste(setdiff(observations_expected, observations_actual), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Extra fields: ", paste(setdiff(observations_actual, observations_expected), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

# Create metadata package

```{r}
properties <-
  frictionless::create_package() %>%
  add_resource(resource_name = "deployments", data = deployments, schema = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tdwg/camtrap-dp/1.0.2/deployments-table-schema.json") %>%
  add_resource(resource_name = "media", data = media, schema = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tdwg/camtrap-dp/1.0.2/media-table-schema.json") %>%
  add_resource(resource_name = "observations", data = observations, schema = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tdwg/camtrap-dp/1.0.2/observations-table-schema.json") %>%
  append(c(
    profile = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tdwg/camtrap-dp/1.0/camtrap-dp-profile.json", # Required modified from 1.0.1 to 1.0 but no effect in .json
    name = "camtrap-dp-rodent-example-metadataset", # Required
    id = NULL,
    created = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", tz = "UTC"), # Required
    title = "National monitoring of rodents with camera traps in Borgefjell, Norway", # Required
    description = NULL,
    version = "1.0",
    keywords = c("rodent", "camera trap", "national monitoring"),
    image = NULL,
    homepage = NULL,
    sources = NULL,
    bibliographicCitation = NULL,
    coordinatePrecision = NULL,
    spatial = NULL, # Required, but keep this empty, this comes later
    temporal = NULL, # Required, but keep this empty, this comes later
    taxonomic = NULL, # Required, but keep this empty, this comes later
    relatedIdentifiers = NULL,
    references = NULL
  )) %>%
  frictionless::create_package()
```

```{r}

properties$contributors <- list( #Required
  list(
    title = "Eivind Flittie Kleiven",
    email = "eivind.kleiven@nina.no",
    path = "https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9556-0195",
    role = "principalInvestigator",
    organization = "Norwegian Institute for Nature Research (NINA)"
  )
)

properties$project <- list( #Required
  title = "National rodent monitoring progam, Norway",
  samplingDesign = "systematicRandom",
  captureMethod = c("activityDetection", "timeLapse"),
  individualAnimals = FALSE,
  observationLevel = c("media", "event")
)

properties$licenses <- list( #Required
  list(
    name = "CC-BY-NC-4.0",
    path = "https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/",
    scope = "data"
  ),
  list(
    name = "CC-BY-NC-4.0",
    path = "https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/",
    scope = "media"
  )
)
```

# Write metadata Package

```{r}
frictionless::write_package(properties, here::here("interim"))
```

# Read with camtrapdp

This automatically updates the spatial, temporal and taxonomic coverage in the metametadata, based on the metadata.

```{r}
properties_dp <- camtrapdp::read_camtrapdp(here::here("interim", "datapackage.json"))
```

# Write Camtrap DP

```{r}
camtrapdp::write_camtrapdp(properties_dp, here::here("processed"))
```

# Fix Camtrap DP JSON errors from converstion through camtrapdp
```{r}
# Fix the schema references that got corrupted by camtrapdp processing
final_package <- jsonlite::fromJSON(here::here("processed", "datapackage.json"))

# Replace the schema arrays with simple URL strings
# The resources is a data.frame, so we access the schema column directly
final_package$resources$schema[[1]] <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tdwg/camtrap-dp/1.0.2/deployments-table-schema.json"
final_package$resources$schema[[2]] <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tdwg/camtrap-dp/1.0.2/media-table-schema.json"
final_package$resources$schema[[3]] <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tdwg/camtrap-dp/1.0.2/observations-table-schema.json"

# Write the corrected package back to file
jsonlite::write_json(final_package, here::here("processed", "datapackage.json"), pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)
```
